import pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"
if not root.is_dir():
    print("PRIVATE_TUMBLR_CONFIG_DIR=ABSENT")
    sys.exit(61)
candidates=[]
for p in root.rglob("*"):
    if len(p.parts)-len(root.parts)>4:continue
    if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():continue
    name=p.name.lower()
    if "oauth" in name and ("token" in name or "access" in name):candidates.append(p)
print("OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE_CANDIDATES="+str(len(candidates)))
if not candidates:sys.exit(62)
PY
